artefacts.name: Singing Sword
artefacts.brand_description:
It radiates damaging sonic waves as it strikes, especially in combat
involving dangerous or numerous foes.

artefacts.name: Wrath of Trog
artefacts.description:
It causes slowness and exhaustion when equipped.
+It extends the wielder's berserk rage when killing foes.

artefacts.name: mace of Variability
artefacts.brand_description:
Each time it hits an enemy it has a different, random effect.
+
+It occasionally unleashes arcs of chaos on nearby creatures upon striking a
foe.

artefacts.name: glaive of Prune
artefacts.description: It halves damage taken while paralysed, petrified or unconscious.

artefacts.name: sword of Power
artefacts.brand_description:
It occasionally discharges a powerful but inaccurate bolt of energy
upon striking a foe, with increased chance the greater the wielder's current
health.

artefacts.name: staff of Olgreb
artefacts.description:
It enhances your poison magic.
+It grants immunity to poison.
+It can be activated via the 'a'bility menu to radiate toxic energy, with
effectiveness depending on Evocations skill.
artefacts.brand_description:
If the wielder is skilled in Evocations, they can envenom those struck
by it, dealing poison damage which bypasses armour.

artefacts.name: staff of Wucad Mu
artefacts.description:
It occasionally powers its wielder's spells, but with a chance of
causing confusion or draining the wielder's intelligence.
+It becomes more likely to activate and less likely to backfire with increased
Evocations skill.

artefacts.name: Vampire's Tooth
artefacts.brand_description:
It occasionally heals its wielder for the full amount of damage dealt
when it wounds a living foe.

artefacts.name: scythe of Curses
artefacts.brand_description: It inflicts powerful necromantic curses on any living foe it strikes.

artefacts.name: sceptre of Torment
artefacts.brand_description:
It occasionally torments all nearby living foes when it strikes in
combat.

artefacts.name: sword of Cerebov
artefacts.brand_description: It temporarily reduces the fire resistance of those it strikes.

artefacts.name: staff of Dispater
artefacts.description:
It can be evoked to hurl damnation at the cost of health and magic,
with strength depending on Evocations skill.

artefacts.name: sceptre of Asmodeus
artefacts.description:
It can be evoked to summon fiery demons, with success rate depending
on Evocations skill. Those summoned this way will remain friendly only for a
limited time.

artefacts.name: demon blade "Leech"
artefacts.brand_description:
It heals its wielder for a portion of the damage dealt every time it
strikes a living foe.

artefacts.name: scythe "Finisher"
artefacts.brand_description:
It may eviscerate those it strikes, slaying them instantly, with a
decreasing chance against stronger foes.

artefacts.name: glaive of the Guard
artefacts.brand_description:
When it strikes, its spirit leaps out and fights alongside the
wielder.

artefacts.name: zealot's sword
artefacts.description:
Whenever the wielder enters a berserk rage, their allies are
berserked alongside them.

artefacts.name: arbalest "Damnation"
artefacts.brand_description:
Any ammunition fired from it explodes in a burst of damnation on
striking a foe, dealing damage which bypasses armour.

artefacts.name: morningstar "Eos"
artefacts.description:
It grants its wielder a halo, revealing invisible creatures and
increasing accuracy against all within it other than the wielder.

artefacts.name: Elemental Staff
artefacts.description: It enhances your fire, ice, earth and air magic.
artefacts.brand_description:
If the wielder is skilled in Evocations, they can discharge powerful
blasts of elemental energy when striking with it.

artefacts.name: heavy crossbow "Sniper"
artefacts.description: Any ammunition fired from it never misses its target.

artefacts.name: lance "Wyrmbane"
artefacts.brand_description: It inflicts extra damage against dragons and draconians.

artefacts.name: Spriggan's Knife
artefacts.description:
It is more effective when stabbing unaware enemies, sometimes treating
them as though they were completely helpless.

artefacts.name: plutonium sword
artefacts.brand_description:
It occasionally inflicts wild transmutation effects on those it
strikes, inflicting malmutation or extra damage, or polymorphing them into a
new form.

artefacts.name: great mace "Undeadhunter"
artefacts.brand_description: It inflicts significantly more damage against the undead.

artefacts.name: whip "Snakebite"
artefacts.brand_description:
It occasionally inflicts asphyxiating poison on those it strikes,
dealing poison damage and causing slowness.

artefacts.name: captain's cutlass
artefacts.brand_description:
It may disarm weapon-wielding foes when striking them, dealing
extra damage in the process.

artefacts.name: storm bow
artefacts.brand_description:
Any ammunition fired by it passes through the targets it hits,
potentially hitting all targets in its path until it reaches maximum range.

artefacts.name: cloak of the Thief
artefacts.description: It may release a thick cloud of smoke when the wearer is hurt.

artefacts.name: hat of the Bear Spirit
artefacts.brand_description: Going berserk makes the wearer tougher, and they're slowed less afterward.

artefacts.name: hood of the Assassin
artefacts.description:
It allows the wearer to sense nearby creatures.
+It allows the wearer to make particularly effective stabbing attacks against
helpless or unaware enemies with any weapon.

artefacts.name: skin of Zhor
artefacts.description:
It radiates cold, occasionally slowing all nearby creatures who are
not resistant to cold.

artefacts.name: salamander hide armour
artefacts.description:
It surrounds you with a cloud of flames.
+It grants immunity to clouds of flame.
+It enhances your fire magic.

artefacts.name: robe of Folly
artefacts.description:
It increases the power of your magical spells.
+It halves the magic cost of your spells (rounding up).
+It reduces your willpower to zero.

artefacts.name: robe of Night
artefacts.description:
It shrouds the wearer in darkness, reducing the range at which they
can see and be seen by others.

artefacts.name: fencer's gloves
artefacts.description:
It allows the wearer to riposte with melee
weapons, swiftly retaliating against missed or blocked melee attacks.

artefacts.name: cloak of Starlight
artefacts.description:
It may blind those who miss an attack against the wearer in melee
combat.

artefacts.name: ratskin cloak
artefacts.description: When the wearer is hurt, rats may emerge from it to assist them.

artefacts.name: shield of the Gong
artefacts.description: It is deafeningly noisy when blocking attacks.

artefacts.name: amulet of the Air
artefacts.description:
It reduces the accuracy of all your attacks.
+It enhances your air magic.

artefacts.name: ring of Shadows
artefacts.description:
It surrounds you with an aura of shadow, increasing your stealth and
reducing the accuracy of all others within it.

artefacts.name: necklace of Bloodlust
artefacts.description: It extends the wearer's berserk rage when killing foes.

artefacts.name: robe of Clouds
artefacts.description:
It occasionally creates storm clouds above nearby enemies.
+It grants its wearer immunity to clouds.

artefacts.name: obsidian axe
artefacts.description:
Its wielder is mesmerised by any visible foes.
+It cannot be unequipped while any foes are visible.
artefacts.brand_description:
It occasionally summons demons to assist the wielder when it strikes
in combat.

artefacts.name: lightning scales
artefacts.description: It allows the wearer to cover ground more swiftly.

artefacts.name: autumn katana
artefacts.description: It sometimes launches melee attacks against multiple visible enemies.

artefacts.name: shillelagh "Devastator"
artefacts.brand_description:
It releases a powerful concussive burst when it strikes, dealing
extra damage to the target and all other foes adjacent to them.

artefacts.name: dragonskin cloak
artefacts.description:
It grants the wearer a chance to resist fire, cold, poison,
electricity, acid, and negative energy.

artefacts.name: macabre finger necklace
artefacts.description: It enables you to equip an extra ring.

artefacts.name: arc blade
artefacts.brand_description:
It occasionally unleashes powerful arcs of lightning upon striking a
foe. These may arc to other adjacent creatures (including the wielder, but
dealing reduced damage to them) before grounding out.

artefacts.name: demon whip "Spellbinder"
artefacts.brand_description:
It unleashes wild and unpredictable magical effects upon striking
a wizard or a creature with magical abilities.

artefacts.name: lajatang of Order
artefacts.brand_description:
It inflicts extra damage upon those it strikes, and deals
substantially increased damage to chaotic, mutated and magically transformed
beings.

artefacts.name: great mace "Firestarter"
artefacts.description: It grants immunity to clouds of flame.
artefacts.brand_description:
It burns those it strikes, dealing additional fire damage.
+
+It fills those it strikes with an explosive inner flame.

artefacts.name: Majin-Bo
artefacts.description: Its wielder's spells cost health as well as magical power.
artefacts.brand_description:
It heals its wielder for a portion of the damage dealt
when they wound a living foe with it or with a spell.

artefacts.name: robe of Vines
artefacts.description: Its wearer cannot be healed by potions.

artefacts.name: Kryia's mail coat
artefacts.description: Potions are twice as effective at healing its wearer.

artefacts.name: frozen axe "Frostbite"
artefacts.description: It grants immunity to clouds of freezing vapour.
artefacts.brand_description:
It freezes those it strikes, dealing additional cold damage. It can
also slow down cold-blooded creatures.
+
+It occasionally leaves clouds of freezing vapour upon striking a foe.

artefacts.name: warlock's mirror
artefacts.description:
It can block and reflect piercing ranged attacks and magical attacks
against the wielder's willpower.

artefacts.name: Maxwell's thermic engine
artefacts.description:
It becomes more effective when it hits something. This effect fades
over time.
artefacts.brand_description:
It freezes those it strikes, dealing additional cold damage. It can
also slow down cold-blooded creatures.

artefacts.name: demon trident "Rift"
artefacts.brand_description:
It can reach especially far, and its reaching attacks ignore other
creatures in the way.

artefacts.name: staff of Battle
artefacts.description:
It enhances your conjuration magic.
+It summons a battlesphere in combat, with strength depending on Conjurations
skill.
+Its strikes trigger the battlesphere's blasts.

artefacts.name: Cigotuvi's embrace
artefacts.description:
It gathers nearby corpses to temporarily increase the armour it
provides.
+It protects you from foul pestilence.

artefacts.name: seven-league boots
artefacts.description:
Its wearer moves as far as possible in that direction when moving
towards enemies.

artefacts.name: Mad Mage's Maulers
artefacts.description:
It empowers its wearer's blows with all of their magic.
+It causes its wearer's magical reserves to regenerate more quickly.

artefacts.name: dreamshard necklace
artefacts.description:
It shatters if its wearer takes lethal or near-lethal damage,
preventing the blow and releasing protective dreams that heal and fight
for the wearer.

artefacts.name: Delatra's gloves
artefacts.description:
It heals its wearer when they drink unknown potions.
+It restores its wearer's MP when they read unknown scrolls.

artefacts.name: Throatcutter
artefacts.brand_description: It may instantly kill foes which have little health.

artefacts.name: staff of the Meek
artefacts.brand_description: It provides extra protection to wielders with little health.

artefacts.name: trishula "Condemnation"
artefacts.brand_description:
It inflicts anguish, making its victims' attacks reflect back on
them.

artefacts.name: mountain boots
artefacts.brand_description:
It prevents involuntary movement, except for blinking,
teleportation, or banishment.

artefacts.name: lochaber axe
artefacts.brand_description:
It can be evoked to extend its reach, and strikes at all foes within reach, dealing less damage to those not targeted.
+It uses either Axes or Polearms skill, whichever is higher.
